title: Bike Flip – Free Dirt Bike Stunt Game (One Button)
description: Play Bike Flip free in your browser: hold to ride, release to lean, flip in mid-air for a turbo boost and reach the finish flag in 20 levels.
body: Hold to ride, release to brake, and race a little dirt bike across a sunset desert to the checkered flag. In the air the same button spins the bike: land a full backflip and you get a turbo boost.

Twenty short levels of 20 to 60 seconds, one button, no text, and up to three stars per level for beating the clock. It works on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and desktops, and your progress is saved automatically.
New here? Read how to play and the tips for three stars.

title: How to Play Bike Flip – Controls, Flips and Stars
description: Bike Flip controls in one line: hold to ride, release to brake. Learn how flips give turbo, how crashes work and how stars are earned.
body: Bike Flip uses a single input. Hold the mouse button, your finger or the Space bar to ride forward. Release to brake.
In the air the same button controls the bike's angle: holding rotates it backwards, releasing tips the nose forward. Use it to land with both wheels on the slope.

Rotate all the way round and land on your wheels to complete a flip. A spinning arrow and a number appear when it counts, and on landing the bike gets a few seconds of turbo with flames from the exhaust. Two flips in one jump give double turbo.
If the rider's helmet touches the ground, or the bike falls into a canyon gap, the level is over: tap the big green button to try again straight away.
Each level has a timer. Reach the flag to unlock the next level and earn one star; beat the target times for two or three stars. Your stars and best times are saved.

title: Bike Flip Tips: Land Flips, Clear Gaps, Get 3 Stars
description: Practical tips for Bike Flip: when to release on ramps, how to land backflips, clearing canyon gaps and earning three stars on every level.
body: Keep holding up the ramp. Speed at the lip decides how far you fly. Letting go on the ramp is the most common reason to fall short of a gap.
Flip on the big drops. Tall ramps followed by a long downhill give the most air time. Hold as soon as you leave the lip and the bike will make it round.
Release early to land. When the bike is about three quarters round, let go: the nose drops and you land on both wheels instead of on your helmet.
Match the slope. Landing parallel to a downhill keeps all your speed. Landing flat on a slope bounces you and costs time.
Turbo is the shortcut to three stars. The target times for three stars are hard to beat without at least one flip per level.
Short taps over bumps. On rocky stretches, tapping keeps both wheels down; holding the whole way makes the bike wheelie.
Steps up? Some gaps land higher than they start. Arrive at full speed and lean back slightly so the rear wheel lands first.

title: Bike Flip for Schools and Kids – Safe, Short, No Sign-up
description: Bike Flip is a short, text-free physics game that works on school Chromebooks: no chat, no purchases, no account, levels under a minute.
h1: Bike Flip for classrooms and kids
body: Bike Flip has no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data. Each level lasts 20 to 60 seconds, which makes it an easy reward between tasks.
There is no text in the game, only numbers and icons, so it works the same for children who are still learning to read and for students of any language.
It is also a playful introduction to physics: speed, momentum, rotation and angles decide whether a jump clears the gap and whether the bike lands on its wheels.
Crashes are cartoon tumbles with no injuries shown. It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones and loads in a couple of seconds (1.6 MB).

title: Bike Flip FAQ
description: Answers about Bike Flip: is it free, does it save, does it work on mobile and Chromebook, how flips and turbo work, how to skip a level.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser.
Does it save my progress? Yes. Unlocked levels, stars and best times are stored in your browser (or in your account on portals that offer it).
Does it work on phones and Chromebooks? Yes, with touch, mouse or keyboard, in landscape or portrait.
Why didn't my flip give turbo? The bike has to rotate a full turn in the air and land on its wheels. If the helmet touches the ground first, the level ends.
I'm stuck on a level. Can I skip it? On some game portals you can watch an optional video after a crash to skip to the next level or to continue from where you fell. It is never required.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.
